files.html: //! window_requests - asking the platform for things beyond the window's contents: fullscreen, a screen kept on, and a //! web page opened. //! //! Each button makes one request. Fullscreen (`z.requestFullscreen`, or F11) is granted in the platform's time - a //! browser grants it only during a click or a key press - so the app asks and then reads the outcome from each frame's //! `f.window.fullscreen`; Escape in a browser, or another request, ends it. Keeping the screen awake (`z.keepAwake`) //! holds off dimming, the screen saver and sleep, as a video player does, until it is turned off. Opening an address //! (`z.openUrl`) shows it in a new tab beside a web app, in the default browser beside a native one; copying it //! (`z.setClipboardText`) puts it on the system clipboard, to paste anywhere. A paste arrives as text for one frame //! (`z.getPastedText`): from Ctrl+V, the system's own paste command, or from the paste button (`z.requestPaste`), //! which a browser may decline without permission to read the clipboard. const std = @import("std"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const z = @import("zimr"); const common = @import("example_common"); const zm = @import("zm"); const float = zm.float; const Color = zm.Color; const Vec2 = zm.Vec2; const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); const page_address: []const u8 = "https://ziglang.org"; const background: Color = .{ .r = 15, .g = 23, .b = 42, .a = 255 }; const button_color: Color = .{ .r = 30, .g = 64, .b = 175, .a = 255 }; const button_hovered: Color = .{ .r = 37, .g = 99, .b = 235, .a = 255 }; const text_color: Color = .{ .r = 226, .g = 232, .b = 240, .a = 255 }; const dim_color: Color = .{ .r = 148, .g = 163, .b = 184, .a = 255 }; const State = struct { font: z.Font, /// Whether the app asked for the screen to stay on; the platform does not report it back. is_keeping_awake: bool = false, /// The beginning of the last text pasted, for its status line. last_paste: [48]u8 = undefined, last_paste_length: usize = 0, }; /// Whether cutting `text` at `cut` would split a character: the byte there continues one (UTF-8 continuation bytes /// are `10xxxxxx`). Cutting at either end splits nothing. fn cutsCharacter(text: []const u8, cut: usize) bool { const is_within_text: bool = cut > 0 and cut < text.len; return is_within_text and text[cut] & 0xc0 == 0x80; } /// Keeps the beginning of a pasted text for display: whole characters only, and line breaks shown as spaces. fn keepPaste(s: *State, text: []const u8) void { var kept_length: usize = @min(text.len, s.last_paste.len); while (cutsCharacter(text, kept_length)) { kept_length -= 1; } for (text[0..kept_length], s.last_paste[0..kept_length]) |byte, *kept| { kept.* = if (byte == '\n' or byte == '\r') ' ' else byte; } s.last_paste_length = kept_length; } /// The buttons, in order. const Button = enum { fullscreen, keep_awake, open_page, copy_address, paste }; fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { s.* = .{ .font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, atkinson_mono_ttf, 18) }; } fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { if (s.is_keeping_awake) { z.keepAwake(false); } z.unloadFont(gpa, s.font); } fn buttonRect(button: Button) z.Rectangle { return .{ .x = 16, .y = 52 + float(@backingInt(button)) * 56, .width = 300, .height = 44 }; } fn isInside(rect: z.Rectangle, point: Vec2) bool { const is_within_columns: bool = point[0] >= rect.x and point[0] < rect.x + rect.width; const is_within_rows: bool = point[1] >= rect.y and point[1] < rect.y + rect.height; return is_within_columns and is_within_rows; } /// A button's label, which says what pressing it does now. fn labelOf(button: Button, s: *const State, is_fullscreen: bool) []const u8 { return switch (button) { .fullscreen => if (is_fullscreen) "leave fullscreen (F11)" else "enter fullscreen (F11)", .keep_awake => if (s.is_keeping_awake) "let the screen rest" else "keep the screen awake", .open_page => "open ziglang.org", .copy_address => "copy the address", .paste => "paste (or Ctrl+V)", }; } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { const pointer: Vec2 = z.getMousePosition(f.input); const clicked: bool = z.isMouseButtonPressed(f.input, .left); const is_fullscreen: bool = f.window.fullscreen; if (z.isKeyPressed(f.input, .f11)) { z.requestFullscreen(!is_fullscreen); } if (z.getPastedText(f.input)) |pasted| { keepPaste(s, pasted); } z.clearViewport(f, background); for (std.enums.values(Button)) |button| { const rect: z.Rectangle = buttonRect(button); const is_hovered: bool = isInside(rect, pointer); if (is_hovered and clicked) { switch (button) { .fullscreen => z.requestFullscreen(!is_fullscreen), .keep_awake => { s.is_keeping_awake = !s.is_keeping_awake; z.keepAwake(s.is_keeping_awake); }, .open_page => z.openUrl(page_address), .copy_address => z.setClipboardText(page_address), .paste => z.requestPaste(), } } f.gl.rect(rect, .{ .color = if (is_hovered) button_hovered else button_color }); const label: []const u8 = labelOf(button, s, is_fullscreen); f.gl.text(.{ rect.x + 14, rect.y + 13 }, label, .{ .size = 18, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); } const status_top: f32 = 52 + float(std.enums.values(Button).len) * 56 + 12; const fullscreen_text: []const u8 = if (is_fullscreen) "fullscreen: yes" else "fullscreen: no"; const awake_text: []const u8 = if (s.is_keeping_awake) "screen kept awake: yes" else "screen kept awake: no"; f.gl.text(.{ 16, status_top }, fullscreen_text, .{ .size = 16, .color = dim_color, .font = &s.font }); f.gl.text(.{ 16, status_top + 24 }, awake_text, .{ .size = 16, .color = dim_color, .font = &s.font }); const pasted_text: []const u8 = s.last_paste[0..s.last_paste_length]; f.gl.textf( .{ 16, status_top + 48 }, "last paste: {s}", .{pasted_text}, .{ .size = 16, .color = dim_color, .font = &s.font }, ); common.caption(f.gl, s.font, "window_requests: fullscreen, a screen kept on, and a page opened"); } pub const app: z.AppSpec(State) = .{ .config = .{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - window requests", .width = 640, .height = 520, .scale_mode = .responsive, }, }, .init = initState, .memory = .managed, .deinit = deinit, .update = update, };
